Reality TV Show Faces Race Row and Fine Threat

The reality television show 'Celebrity Traitors' is embroiled in a race row after a banished contestant, Myha'la, claimed the existence of 'unconscious racial bias' within the game. Separately, the show's cast has been warned they could face a £100,000 fine if they reveal any secrets from the program.
